mentions.name: third thoughts
mentions.description: A tool that analyses local agent logs to find patterns and behaviours, identifying what works, what doesn't, and how agents evolve over time, using deterministic and statistical methodologies from multiple domains, with an agent layer that interprets the results. A planned "federative" layer would let people contribute results, patterns, and findings without leaking their logs or personal/private data, to help identify and predict failure modes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m also working on third thoughts[^1], a tool that analyses local agents logs to find patterns and behaviours, identify what works, what doesn’t, how they evolve over time, using deterministic and statistical methodologies and techniques from multiple domains (including, to my surprise, genetics and psychology / sociology), with an agent layer that interprets the results.
